title: IndiaAI Mission
summary: The Union Cabinet approved the IndiaAI Mission in March 2024 with an outlay of ₹10,371.92 crore over five years. IndiaAI, an independent business division under MeitY, runs it through seven pillars: compute capacity, the AIKosh datasets platform, application development, foundation models, FutureSkills, startup financing, and safe and trusted AI. By December 2025 the government reported 38,000 GPUs onboarded and twelve foundation-model teams selected. PRS notes that spending has stayed below half of each year's allocation, and the 2026-27 budget allocation fell to ₹1,000 crore from ₹2,000 crore in 2025-26.
beneficiaries: Startups, researchers, academia, students and government bodies
